The '''Shesh family''' was a [[Kuati/Legends|Kuati]] family related to Kuati royalty.

==History==
Based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]], a world famed for its shipbuilding industries, the Shesh family was a wealthy shipbuilding dynasty heavily involved with [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]]. With close ties to [[Kuat of Kuat/Legends|Kuat of Kuat]], the head of KDY, the Shesh family suffered when the administrator committed [[Death/Legends|suicide]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], destroying much of the Kuat Drive Yards in the process. The Shesh family lost wealth, influence and prestige during the subsequent reconstruction efforts and turned to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], which installed itself on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in [[6 ABY/Legends|6.5 ABY]]. Contracting secretly with the New Republic, the Shesh family gained massively when the remnant of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] retreated from the [[Kuat system/Legends|Kuat system]] in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]]. Affiliates of the New Republic signed billion [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]] deals with the Shesh family, who regained their lost wealth and more.<ref name="negtc">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref>

==Notable members==
[[Viqi Shesh]] was a famous member of the Shesh family who represented Kuat in the [[New Republic Senate/Legends|New Republic Senate]] from [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]] until [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]].<ref name="negtc" /> Shesh began her career in Kuati corporate marketing but used her family's wealth to fund her campaign for office. During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], Shesh gained galactic infamy after collaborating with the invading [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Species/Legends|species]], to whom she furtively channeled a large amount of secret information concerning the New Republic in exchange for a role in the Yuuzhan Vong administration.<ref name="nec">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Shesh's dealings came to light during the [[Battle of Coruscant (Yuuzhan Vong War)|conquest]] of Coruscant in 27 ABY and she died shortly thereafter, committing suicide so as to avoid death or punishment at hands other than her own.<ref name="el2">''[[The New Jedi Order: Enemy Lines II: Rebel Stand]]''</ref>
